## About this item
- ELEGANT DESIGN: Features five ornate chakra charms adorned with sparkling crystal stones set in a floral pattern on a delicate gold-toned wire chain.
- VERSATILE STYLE: This necklace beautifully complements traditional Indian ethnic wear such as sarees, lehengas, and salwar suits, perfect for festive and special occasions.
- ADJUSTABLE FIT: Equipped with a multi-ring extension chain and hook clasp closure, allowing you to adjust the length for a comfortable and customised fit.
- SPARKLING EMBELLISHMENTS: Each circular charm showcases a central crystal stone surrounded by intricate beaded gold-toned detailing and a sparkling outer halo of white stones.
- LIGHTWEIGHT AND COMFORTABLE: The slim wire chain and lightweight medallion charms make this necklace easy to wear for extended periods without discomfort.

## Product description
Elevate your ethnic look with this stunning gold-toned necklace featuring five intricately crafted Chakra pendants. Each medallion showcases a beautiful floral motif at its centre, surrounded by sparkling white stone embellishments that catch the light with every movement. The delicate gold wire chain keeps the design lightweight and comfortable to wear, while the adjustable hook-and-ring clasp ensures a perfect fit for all neck sizes. This elegant piece transitions effortlessly from festive celebrations to wedding functions and traditional occasions. It pairs beautifully with sarees, lehengas, and embroidered ethnic wear, as seen styled with a teal embroidered anarkali. The graceful arrangement of the five graduated medallions creates a balanced, eye-catching neckline that is sure to draw compliments. Whether you are dressing up for a festival, a family gathering, or a special ceremony, this necklace adds a touch of timeless charm and sophistication to any ensemble.
